title: Continuity of the orthogonal projections onto the rotated tangent planes of a C^1 graph
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, R real, u : R^n -> R^l C^1 on the open ball Bo_R(0), G(z) := graphPoint z (u z), and Q a linear isometry equivalence of R^(n+l). Then the map x -> orthogonal projection onto Q(range DG(x)), as a continuous linear endomorphism of R^(n+l) (i.e. (Submodule.map Q (range (fderiv R G x))).starProjection), is continuous on Bo_R(0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → ContinuousOn (fun x : Rn n => (Submodule.map Q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun z : Rn n => graphPoint z (u z)) x).toLinearMap)).starProjection) (ball 0 R)
